input.reply:
Thanks for the report and the repro. The ResizeObserver loop error is expected in your example, because the callback grows the element on every notification. The problem is that Vitest prints a bare `null` to stderr instead of the error. Browsers report this as a window `error` event whose `error` property is `null`, so the real message is probably lost when the event is formatted.

I couldn't search existing issues or the source with the tools available to me in this triage, so I haven't confirmed whether this is already tracked or where the `null` is produced. Please check whether it happens in both browser mode (Playwright) and jsdom/happy-dom. Also note which environment your linked repro uses. That will help narrow down where the error event is handled.

This is not a promise of a fix. A maintainer will need to look at how error events with a null `error` are reported.
